The plan says edges join comparable labels (K3.3, quoting line 998) and that dimension changes are counted, but never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions.

K3.6 states that over F_2 each nonzero residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating (contains a norm-one vector), hence has an orthonormal basis; the plane-absorption argument itself is not spelled out.
K5a.2 states that orthogonal binary vectors have even support intersection, so weight is additive mod 4 and q_V-q_U is the sum of wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal residual basis.

K5a.7 gives zero source and full sink labels telescoping to C^{otimes m}, and K5a.8 gives C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u), repaired via C=iZC^{-1}Z with sign corrections and phase i^{27k}; the final negation of the X outputs is not stated.

K4b asserts the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones (quoting the lemma statement at line 1366) but gives no elimination proof (topmost row, rightmost pivot, lower-triangular clearing, active indices).

K5d.6 gives depth-ell values in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^ell with p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits exact, and K5d.8 gives epsilon C_1<1 so Delta=o(p).
